parameters.name: walletIds

parameters.name: syncIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated sync run ids (max 100); txns with any leg written by one of these syncs. A re-sync does not re-stamp rows that already exist; legs with no sync id (manual entries, legacy or edited detected transfers) never match

parameters.name: importSourceTypes
parameters.description: Comma-separated: API,CSV,Manual

parameters.name: assetIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated UUIDs

parameters.name: fromAddresses
parameters.description: Comma-separated

parameters.name: toAddresses
parameters.description: Comma-separated

parameters.name: addresses
parameters.description: Comma-separated; matches either side (sender or receiver)

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Comma-separated

parameters.name: ledgerTypes
parameters.description: Comma-separated: incoming,outgoing,fee

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated

parameters.name: hasComments
parameters.description: With/without comments: true = has at least one comment, false = none

parameters.name: isHighPnLReviewed
parameters.description: Reconciliation review flag: filter reviewed/unreviewed high-PnL transactions

parameters.name: isUncategorisedIgnored
parameters.description: Reconciliation review flag: filter ignored uncategorized deposits/withdrawals

parameters.name: isMissingPriceIgnored
parameters.description: Reconciliation review flag: filter ignored missing-price transactions

parameters.name: minTotalGains
parameters.description: High-PnL threshold: matches transactions whose gain OR loss magnitude is at least this value (totalGains >= value OR totalGains <= -value). Used by the high-PnL reconciliation view.

parameters.name: minValue
parameters.description: Min net fiat value (transactions.netValue.fiatValue). Compared as numeric, so transactions whose fiatValue is null (any leg unpriced) are excluded, not treated as 0.

parameters.name: maxValue
parameters.description: Max net fiat value (transactions.netValue.fiatValue). Compared as numeric, so transactions whose fiatValue is null (any leg unpriced) are excluded, not treated as 0.

parameters.name: notLabels
parameters.description: Comma-separated; exclude these labels

parameters.name: notTypes
parameters.description: Comma-separated; exclude these types

parameters.name: notImportSourceTypes
parameters.description: Comma-separated; exclude API/CSV/Manual

parameters.name: notTags
parameters.description: Comma-separated; exclude txns carrying any of these tags

parameters.name: notWalletIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated; exclude txns with any transfer on these accounts

parameters.name: notSyncIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated (max 100); exclude txns with any leg produced by these syncs

parameters.name: notAssetIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated; exclude txns with any transfer in these assets/currencies

parameters.name: notProviders
parameters.description: Comma-separated; exclude txns with any transfer from these providers

parameters.name: notLedgerTypes
parameters.description: Comma-separated; exclude txns with any transfer of these ledger types

parameters.name: notFromAddresses
parameters.description: Comma-separated; exclude by sender address

parameters.name: notToAddresses
parameters.description: Comma-separated; exclude by recipient address

parameters.name: trxId
parameters.description: Exact match on the transaction's own id (the `id` field returned in responses).

parameters.name: trxHash
parameters.description: Exact match on the platform-supplied transaction id — a CEX order id or an on-chain transaction hash, depending on source.

parameters.name: coaTagStatus
parameters.description: COA tagging filter (enterprise). A leg is complete when it carries the COA side(s) its transaction type requires — both for deposit/withdrawal/payment, one for trade/transfer legs, and always both for a fee leg. tagged = every leg is complete, fee legs included; partial = some work is done and something is still missing; untagged = nothing is done. Progress is judged on non-fee legs only (fee codes are assigned automatically, so an auto-coded gas leg is not 'started'), falling back to the fee legs on a fee-only transaction. Ignored for retail.

parameters.name: coaSyncStatus
parameters.description: COA ERP-sync filter (enterprise): synced = pushed; unsynced = journal exists, not yet pushed.

parameters.name: coaTagged
parameters.description: Deprecated — use coaTagStatus (true→tagged, false→untagged).

parameters.name: syncedToERP
parameters.description: Deprecated — use coaSyncStatus (true→synced, false→unsynced).

parameters.name: includeSpam
parameters.description: Include spam-labelled transactions. Default excludes them.

parameters.name: includeIgnored
parameters.description: Include Ignore-labelled transactions. Default excludes them.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Unix ms

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Unix ms

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip. Each request reads and discards every skipped row, so deep offsets get slower page by page and can time out on large workspaces. To read a whole workspace, use `cursor`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Keyset paging: pass `meta.nextCursor` from the previous page to get the rows after it. Every page costs the same at any depth, and rows sharing a timestamp are never repeated or skipped. Only with `sortBy=timestamp` (the default) and `offset=0`; keep the same filters and `sortOrder` across pages (a cursor sent with a different `sortOrder` is rejected with 400). Opaque: do not build or edit it.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Nullable columns (`netValue`, `totalGains`) always sort NULLS LAST in both directions, so unpriced/no-gain transactions never bury the real values at the top of a `desc` page.
